reviews.body:
## Pull request overview

Localizes sidebar navigation strings and mobile sidebar screen-reader-only labels by moving hardcoded UI text into the i18n `common` namespace, keeping EN/KO translations in sync.

**Changes:**
- Localized the “Scheduled Tasks” tooltip/label in `AppSidebar.tsx` using existing `sidebar.scheduledTasks`.
- Localized mobile sidebar `SheetTitle`/`SheetDescription` SR-only text in `ui/sidebar.tsx` via new `sidebar.mobileTitle` and `sidebar.mobileDescription` keys.
- Updated `en/common.json` and `ko/common.json` with the new sidebar keys and logged the extraction in `.jules/rosetta.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| src/components/layout/AppSidebar.tsx | Replaces hardcoded “Scheduled Tasks” strings with `t('sidebar.scheduledTasks')` for label + tooltip. |
| src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx | Uses `useTranslation('common')` to localize SR-only mobile sidebar title/description. |
| src/locales/en/common.json | Adds `sidebar.mobileTitle` and `sidebar.mobileDescription` translations (EN). |
| src/locales/ko/common.json | Adds `sidebar.mobileTitle` and `sidebar.mobileDescription` translations (KO). |
| .jules/rosetta.md | Records the localization extraction entry for the sidebar updates. |
</details>
